initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-53102. The requested source changes appear in ceedc43fb48fa41b06d58d9a70d58c3fb3454c87, a 2025-10-22 terminology cleanup commit titled for FHIR-23876 that changed PlanDefinition.action.type and RequestOrchestration.action.type to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/action-type and deleted source/plandefinition/valueset-action-type.xml.
additional_context: In the current R6 source, source/fhir.ini lists PlanDefinition and RequestOrchestration as active resources and maps RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration. The CDS 2025-10-15 Confluence agenda/minutes corroborate the 13-0-0 vote for FHIR-53102, and issue-specific Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the current build-scope XML already implements the Jira resolution.
